instantiated_cells.justification: Section 13.64(1) requires a principal to register within 10 days after making lobbying expenditures or incurring obligations exceeding $500 in a calendar year (and §13.621(5) provides the parallel exemption for those not exceeding $500).

Section 13.68(1)(a)6. requires the name, address, and total of lobbying expenditures to be itemized for each lobbyist only if the total amount made or incurred to that lobbyist exceeds $200 during the reporting period.

Section 13.621(5) exempts principals anticipating aggregate lobbying expenditures or obligations not exceeding $500 in a calendar year from reporting requirements under §13.68 if they file a verified statement.

Section 13.68(1)(bn) requires the principal to estimate time spent on any legislative proposal, administrative rule, budget bill subject, or topic that accounts for 10 percent or more of the principal's lobbying time during the reporting period.

input.justification: Section 13.64(1) requires a principal to register within 10 days after making lobbying expenditures or incurring obligations exceeding $500 in a calendar year (and §13.621(5) provides the parallel exemption for those not exceeding $500).

Section 13.62(11) provides that if an individual's duties are not limited exclusively to lobbying, the individual is a lobbyist only if he or she makes lobbying communications on each of at least 5 days within a reporting period.

Section 13.68(1)(a)6. requires the name, address, and total of lobbying expenditures to be itemized for each lobbyist only if the total amount made or incurred to that lobbyist exceeds $200 during the reporting period.

Section 13.621(5) exempts principals anticipating aggregate lobbying expenditures or obligations not exceeding $500 in a calendar year from reporting requirements under §13.68 if they file a verified statement.

Section 13.68(1)(bn) requires the principal to estimate time spent on any legislative proposal, administrative rule, budget bill subject, or topic that accounts for 10 percent or more of the principal's lobbying time during the reporting period.
